observation.methodology_note: Sum unemployed / sum labor force × 100 for 50 states + DC; Puerto Rico and counties excluded. Not an official CPS national rate.

unemployment_definition_evidence.definition: unemployed/civilian labor force age16+ in BLS LAUS; counts, not rounded published rates
unemployment_definition_evidence.national_distinction: Official CPS national series not loaded; sum of seasonally adjusted state LAUS counts remains derived. NSA real-time benchmarking does not prove equivalence of this SA aggregate.

reconciliation.basis: Excluded county-code-000 rows from the same county publication, not another IRS state series.

limitations: Published disclosure-protected AGI cells only; merged/excluded/dominance-protected cells cannot be reverse engineered.
County-file state total is not interchangeable with the native IRS state statistical publication.
Tax-return-address geography and filing population, not all residents.
Source dollars are in thousands; no per-return denominator selected.

policy: Under-20-return AGI classes can be combined within county; Excel identifies collapsed classes.
Under-20-return county items and dominance-protected individual items can be excluded.
Numeric CSV zero is not proof of an unsuppressed true zero or permission to reconstruct protected cells.
County publication excludes unmatched/missing ZIP codes and certain non-US return addresses.
IRS warns county-file state totals may differ from state totals published elsewhere.
Dollar amounts are in thousands; counts are rounded to nearest ten.

unemployment_state.note: Descriptive distribution; ranks indicate numerical order, not desirability. No population-weighted statistic or visual normalization inferred.

remaining_product_choice: Total published AGI versus AGI per return is not selected. Native state and county publication totals stay distinct.
